cast.expression: total_amount - fare_amount - tip_amount - tolls_amount - extra - mta_tax - improvement_surcharge
cast.justification: fare_gap is an ungrounded derived measure on the baseline (no dbt lineage, plain non-modeled table). FSA confirmed (Q&A round 2, fare_gap_fallback=opt-0) that grounding proceeds against the wider Target column inventory since no manifest expression exists to trace. Diagnostic profiling (aggregate sums by pickup_borough/trip_day, surcharge-component breakdowns) isolated this exact formula as an exact match to baseline's fare_gap for every one of the 1457 baseline rows, distinguishing it from the Target's own pre-existing fare_residual measure (fct_trip.fare_residual / int_trip_fare_components.sql), which nets out congestion_surcharge in addition to the components fare_gap excludes -- baseline's fare_gap does NOT net out congestion_surcharge, so it is a narrower reconstruction than the modeled fare_residual.

tolerances.reason: DOUBLE-typed monetary sum; 0.02 absorbs float aggregation rounding noise observed across all rows.
